text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Six solar farms of National Grid Electricity Distribution (NGED), daylight hours, March 2024 to April 2026. IFS: ECMWF's forecast via Open-Meteo. Post hoc, exploratory: added after the first results, with no negative control. Not corrected for multiple comparisons. Filled purple dot: mean absolute error with the main XGBoost model settings, pooled over lead days 1 to 3. Hollow ring, drawn just under its row's dot: the same with the second settings, a check that the result does not depend on them. Orange line: 95% interval of that step alone at the main settings, from resampling whole months, drawn from the row below's dot, which is the step's zero. The page's verdicts use 99% intervals, given in its text. A minus sign in the right column means the error fell. The axis does not start at zero. Each added row has more input variables: FP has 13, FP + total cloud 14, FP + total cloud + layers 17. FP: F0 plus dew point, pressure, precipitation, and wind speed, the variables the production forecast already receives. Total cloud: the model also gets total cloud cover. Layers: it also gets low, mid, and high cloud cover, which ECMWF's free open-data feed does not carry.'
text.tspan: Six solar farms of National Grid Electricity Distribution (NGED), daylight hours, March 2024 to April 2026. IFS:
ECMWF's forecast via Open-Meteo.
Post hoc, exploratory: added after the first results, with no negative control. Not corrected for multiple
comparisons.
Filled purple dot: mean absolute error with the main XGBoost model settings, pooled over lead days 1 to 3. Hollow
ring, drawn just under its row's dot: the same with the second settings, a check that the result does not depend on
them.
Orange line: 95% interval of that step alone at the main settings, from resampling whole months, drawn from the row
below's dot, which is the step's zero. The page's verdicts use 99% intervals, given in its text.
A minus sign in the right column means the error fell. The axis does not start at zero. Each added row has more
input variables: FP has 13, FP + total cloud 14, FP + total cloud + layers 17.
FP: F0 plus dew point, pressure, precipitation, and wind speed, the variables the production forecast already
receives.
Total cloud: the model also gets total cloud cover. Layers: it also gets low, mid, and high cloud cover, which
ECMWF's free open-data feed does not carry.
